stem: Last week the web team put a redirect in front of the old campaign landing pages. Since then Google Ads sessions in GA4 fell and Direct rose, although auto-tagging is still on and ad clicks in Google Ads are steady. What do you check first?

options.text: Whether the redirect keeps the gclid parameter on the URL of the page it sends people to
Whether utm_source and utm_medium were added to the ads to override the auto-tagging
Whether event data retention fell to 2 months in the same week the redirect went live
Whether the Ads link lost its personalized advertising setting during the work on the redirect
